label.purpose: Uppercase table headers and status badges.

mono.purpose: Order numbers, IDs, import row numbers.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Role-accent main action; green in company area, blue in partner area.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: #689c6d; color: #fff; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 100ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #578462; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(104,156,109,0.35); }

components.name: Hero Button
components.description: The single main page action, e.g. partner 'Neue Bestellung'.
components.html: <button class="ds-button-hero"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>Neue Bestellung</button>
components.css: .ds-button-hero { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: #5e838d; color: #fff; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 100ms; } .ds-button-hero:hover { background: #4a6870; } .ds-button-hero:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(140,172,179,0.40); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #b5c8b9; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: #fff; color: #0b110c; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #edf2ee; border-color: #8ca594; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(104,156,109,0.35); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labelled form input with accent focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-field span { font-weight: 600; color: #3d4f43; } .ds-field input { height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid #b5c8b9; border-radius: 0.375rem; font: inherit; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #689c6d; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(104,156,109,0.35); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Order/partner status: tinted pill with mandatory text.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; padding: 0.125rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-badge--submitted { background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e; } .ds-badge--fulfilled { background: #d0fae5; color: #166534; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav
components.description: Light sidebar items; active item on accent tint.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 15rem; padding: 0.75rem; background: #fff; border-right: 1px solid #d6e1d8; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 0.75rem; border-radius: 0.375rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #3d4f43; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav a:hover { background: #edf2ee; color: #0b110c; } .ds-nav a.is-active { background: #eff5f6; color: #5e838d; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Metric Card
components.description: Dashboard value with label and role-tinted icon.
components.css: .ds-metric { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; padding: 1.5rem; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #d6e1d8; border-radius: 0.5rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(11,17,12,0.09); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-metric__icon { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: #f0f7f1; color: #578462; font-weight: 700; } .ds-metric__value { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: #578462; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-metric__label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #52675a; }

narrative.overview: PAPO is the tool a sales partner opens to get an order for their customer done, and the tool the company uses to process it. The interface behaves like a dependable colleague: calm, tidy, always clear about what happens next, and quietly encouraging. Density serves data; colour is a signal, never decoration. This is a refinement system that preserves Tobias' tokens and look.
keyCharacteristics: One role accent per area, switched once on the shell (.area--company / .area--partner).
Light sidebar, white content cards, subtle green-tinted shadows.
Status always shown as text badge plus colour.
One main action per page, visibly larger ("Neue Bestellung").
Money and counts in tabular figures; amounts never ambiguous.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Every role-aware element reads --color-accent* / --text-brand; naming a role palette step directly is a bug.

rules.name: The Signal Not Paint Rule
rules.body: Green and blue never appear together as decoration; semantic colours only for their status.

rules.name: The Contrast Debt Rule
rules.body: Resting primary button and active nav text fail AA; proposal: step 700 resting, 800 hover, nav text 700.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Amounts, counts and percentages use tabular figures and German formatting.

rules.name: The Border First Rule
rules.body: Separate with a 1px border before a stronger shadow; no coloured accent stripes.

dos: Do read role colours only through --color-accent* / --text-brand.
Do give each page at most one hero action; everything else regular or secondary.
Do pair every status colour with a German text label.
Do keep visible focus (accent ring) on every interactive element and 44px touch targets on mobile.
Do use tabular figures and German formatting for money.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion; transitions stay at 100–250ms.
donts: Don't introduce new colours, fonts, dark mode or a CSS framework.
Don't hardcode --color-primary-* / --color-accent-* or hex values for role colour in components.
Don't use the teal secondary ramp as partner colour.
Don't use Text Disabled (#8ca594) or 300/400 accent steps for readable text.
Don't add coloured side stripes or decorative gradients to containers.
